description: This file contains utility functions for FastAPI, including model creation, route ID generation, type handling, and response modeling support, specific to the FastAPI framework's internal mechanisms.

methods.name: bool is_body_allowed_for_status_code(status_code: Union[int, str, None])
methods.description: Determines if a response body is permissible for a given status code based on HTTP standards and OpenAPI specifications.

methods.name: set[str] get_path_param_names(path: str)
methods.description: Extracts path parameter names enclosed in curly braces from a URL path string.

methods.name: ModelField create_model_field( name: str, type_: Any, class_validators: Optional[dict[str, Validator]] = None, default: Optional[Any] = Undefined, required: Union[bool, UndefinedType] = Undefined, model_config: Union[type[BaseConfig], None] = None, field_info: Optional[FieldInfo] = None, alias: Optional[str] = None, mode: Literal["validation", "serialization"] = "validation", version: Literal["1", "auto"] = "auto", )
methods.description: Constructs a Pydantic ModelField with specified parameters, handling validation and serialization modes, and ensuring compatibility with FastAPI's model generation.

methods.name: ModelField create_cloned_field( field: ModelField, *, cloned_types: Optional[MutableMapping[type[BaseModel], type[BaseModel]]] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a clone of a given ModelField, with support for caching cloned types (though currently a direct return).

methods.name: str generate_operation_id_for_path( *, name: str, path: str, method: str )
methods.description: Generates a unique operation ID string for an API endpoint based on route name, path, and method, deprecated in favor of newer mechanisms.

methods.name: str generate_unique_id(route: "APIRoute")
methods.description: Creates a unique identifier for an API route based on route properties, used for OpenAPI operation IDs.

methods.name: None deep_dict_update(main_dict: dict[Any, Any], update_dict: dict[Any, Any])
methods.description: Recursively updates a dictionary with another dictionary, merging nested dictionaries and concatenating lists.

methods.name: Union[DefaultPlaceholder,DefaultType] get_value_or_default( first_item: Union[DefaultPlaceholder, DefaultType], *extra_items: Union[DefaultPlaceholder, DefaultType], )
methods.description: Returns the first non-placeholder value from given items, used to prioritize default or override values.
